_comment: v1.12.0 - subsection markers for the Latin of the ten Book I excerpts of the Bellum Civile. Both translations were written with their markers already at these boundaries and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries them. Boundaries from Perseus (CTS phi0448.phi002), word-exact; all ten are whole chapters. The Latin Library and Perseus disagree in several places, so seven sections need `overrides` giving the app's own wording: I.9.2 is the famous crux (`Sibi semper primam rei publicae fuisse dignitatem` against Perseus' shorter `sibi semper primam fuisse dignitatem`), I.9.4 and I.23.4 are spelling and numeral notation, I.22.3 and I.74.2 are extra words in the source, I.74.6 is `Afranii` for `Afrani`, and I.23.2 is a substantive variant - `Erant quinquaginta` against `erant quinque senatorii ordinis`.

overrides.2: Sibi semper primam rei publicae fuisse dignitatem

overrides.3: Cum eo de salute sua agit
